Here’s a quick mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films you might enjoy:

| # | Title | Year | Sub‑genre / Notable Element |
|---|-------|------|-----------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Psychological horror – iconic haunted hotel, Jack Nicholson’s descent into madness. |
| 2 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Social thriller – satire on race relations wrapped in a chilling plot. |
| 3 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | Family trauma meets supernatural dread; intense atmosphere and shocking twists. |
| 4 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | Silence‑based tension – a family surviving in a world where sound attracts monsters. |
| 5 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Daylight horror – unsettling folk rituals set against a bright Swedish summer. |
| 6 | **It Follows** | 2014 | Modern folklore – a curse passed through sexual contact, eerie synth score. |
| 7 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Psychological horror – a monster that emerges from a children’s book. |
| 8 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | Paranormal investigation – based on real‑life cases of Ed & Lorraine Warren. |
| 9 | **Suspiria** (1977) | 1977 | Giallo style – surreal visuals, haunting soundtrack, occult dance academy. |
|10 | **The Witch** | 2015 | Historical period horror – isolated Puritan family confronting an ancient evil. |

Feel free to let me know if you’re looking for something more specific—like slasher flicks, supernatural thrillers, or low‑budget indie gems—and I can tailor the list further!
